newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar rallies in moderate volume.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar rallies in moderate volume.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar had another strong day on Tuesday, moving almost a full Canadian cent stronger to close at C$1.3560 (US$0.7375) from Monday's close at C$1.3650 (US$0.7326). * The Bank of Canada intervened to buy U.S.
dollars at C$1.3575 (US$0.7366) to smooth the currency's gains, traders said. * Volume was moderate.
The intervention helped push the currency to the C$1.3560 range by early afternoon, where it traded the rest of the day.
The currency is picking up strength as market players return to the market after the holiday season and recognize solid Canadian fundamentals, traders said.
Gregory said he expects the currency will consolidate in the C$1.3540 to C$1.3590 range, where it was trading for much of 1996.
"I think the currency is very happy in that range," he said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.1535 marks from Monday's close at 1.1446 marks and increased to 84.95 yen from 84.70 yen on Monday.
